item.decade.ruin_wand.tip1: Admin tool, works for operators only
item.decade.ruin_wand.tip2: Left / right click a block: the two corners of a selection
item.decade.ruin_wand.tip3: Sneak + right click a block: can the cell in front of that face hold a crate
item.decade.ruin_wand.tip4: Sneak + left click a block: add or remove a spawn point in that cell
item.decade.ruin_wand.tip5: Shows nearby ruins while held; sneak + right click the air to clear the selection
